key_insight: A spatial-physical coupling operator extends convolution into a joint spatial-variable dimension to better reconstruct three-dimensional turbulence from low-resolution data.
engineering_relevance: The approach could improve turbulent-flow reconstruction when simulation costs or measurement hardware limit spatial resolution.
method: Construct a unified spatial-physical representation within CNNs.
Explicitly model local interactions between physical variables beyond conventional linear channel mixing.
Lift features into a higher-dimensional representation using an architecture-agnostic operator.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong reconstruction performance and zero-shot generalization, but provides no datasets, numerical metrics, or evaluation details.
watch_item: The computational and memory costs of the higher-dimensional representation are not specified in the abstract.
paper_title: A high-dimensional spatial-physical coupling operator for generalizable super-resolution of three-dimensional turbulent flows
